title: Stop rebuilding the context value on every render
summary: A memoized ProductCard still re-renders on every keystroke in search. Pin the context value, then split the context into items and actions.

turns.user: put memo on ProductCard and every card still re-renders on each keystroke in the search box. saw it in the Profiler. CartProvider lives inside Shop

assistant.body: Great catch. When Shop re-renders for query, CartProvider renders again and hands value a brand new object. Context compares value with Object.is, so an object with the same contents still counts as changed, and every component calling useCart re-renders. memo only compares props. In other words, a context update walks straight past it. Let's pin the references with useCallback and useMemo.

turns.user: search is fine now. but adding one item re-renders every card. there are 100 of them

assistant.body: I take that back. useMemo is not enough while items sits in the same value, because every change to items still reaches every consumer. On top of that, addItem depended on items, so it was rebuilt on every add. The fix is to split the context into items and actions. Written as functional updates to setItems, the actions never read items, so useMemo gets an empty dependency list and the reference never changes.
ProductCard only needs the actions. Anything that shows items, such as a count badge, reads useCartItems instead.

turns.user: rename addItem to addToCart to match the API. both files

assistant.body: Done in one pass. addItem only appears in these two files, and removeItem does not match the pattern, so it stays as it is.
